definitions.explanation: The soft tissue of the body.

examples.english: Since I've been running and swimming every day to stay active, my arms and legs have become much more muscular.

notes:
{肉|にく} refers to meat (for food) or flesh (body tissue).

TYPES OF MEAT:
- ⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧: beef
- ⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧: pork
- ⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧/⟦{鳥肉|とりにく}→鳥肉：noentry⟧: chicken
- ⟦{羊肉|ようにく}→羊肉：30426_youniku⟧: lamb, mutton
- ⟦{馬肉|ばにく}→馬肉：30430_baniku⟧: horse meat

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{焼肉|やきにく}→焼肉：04984_yakiniku⟧: grilled meat (Korean-style BBQ)
- ⟦{肉屋|にくや}→肉屋：15233_nikuya⟧: butcher shop
- ⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧: muscle
- ⟦{肉料理|にくりょうり}→肉料理：19402_nikuryouri⟧: meat dishes
- ⟦ひき{肉|にく}→挽肉：14783_hikiniku⟧: ground meat

USAGE NOTE:
When used alone, {肉|にく} often defaults to beef or pork depending on context. In casual speech, people may say お{肉|にく} with the polite prefix.
